spans.s: lakaṭā (IE 8-8), meaning uncertain. Cf. ārdraka-lakaṭā, probably, dried ginger stick or undried fire-wood.

lakṣaṇa (IA 18), the sexual parts; the male organ; cf. nirlakṣitavya, to be castrated.
 (CII 1), branding.
 (SII 3; SITI), a document or deed; an inscription.
Lakṣaṇ-ādhyakṣa (HRS), according to the Arthaśāstra, the superintendent of the mint, or royal dues received by the superintendent of the mint.
Lākula, also called Lākuleśvara (EI 15), a Śaiva sect following Lakulīśa.
Lakuleśvar-āgama (CITD), a form of Śaivism associated with Lakulīśa.
